All I’m asking is for BlinkDrama to bring in more original stories, fresh plots, and different endings instead of constantly recycling the same storylines with different characters. title: Very entertaining and cleanly executed AI work
body: I have been perusing multiple AI drama accounts and this one is among my favorites because of how few “movie mistakes” there are, how they don’t indulge in gratuitous sexual content and how generous they are with their coins. This app offers a trial week at a reduced price for lower cost binge watching and I think it’s well worth the money to sample it for a week. Should you decide not to pay, you earn coins through daily check-ins and brief ads that earn enough coins to watch and entire series through to the end. They also give you coins for every 5 minutes you watch which is more than other apps provide! The reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because of consistent name mispronunciation and the way every chapter ends with a resounding “POP” and a scattering of what looks like blurred firefly light. I would prefer a smoother transition from chapter to chapter like KalosTV has. The annual fee is $119 which is way less than most AI drama apps and a great way to pass the time doing household chores or driving.
